items.name: Finset.finsupp
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Zero α] (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → Finset α) : Finset (ι →₀ α)

items.name: Finset.card_finsupp
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Zero α] (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → Finset α) : (s.finsupp t).card = ∏ i ∈ s, (t i).card

items.name: Finset.mem_finsupp_iff
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Zero α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι →₀ α} {t : ι → Finset α} : f ∈ s.finsupp t ↔ f.support ⊆ s ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, f i ∈ t i

items.name: Finset.mem_finsupp_iff_of_support_subset
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Zero α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι →₀ α} {t : ι →₀ Finset α} (ht : t.support ⊆ s) : f ∈ s.finsupp ⇑t ↔ ∀ (i : ι), f i ∈ t i

items.name: Finsupp.Icc_eq
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [PartialOrder α] [Zero α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq α] (f g : ι →₀ α) : Finset.Icc f g = (f.support ∪ g.support).finsupp ⇑(f.rangeIcc g)
